notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2023 remake; RAWG's first search result was the 2008 game, so the remake's entry "dead-space-5" (id 638654) was put in by hand. It uses its own Steam app, 1693980 ("Dead Space"); the 2008 game is app 17470. The Steam schema calls the app "Beyond" (an internal codename). StrategyWiki has no page under "Dead Space (2023)"; its "Dead Space" page covers both the 2008 game and the remake (its categories list 2008 and 2023, EA Redwood Shores and Motive Studio) and is at completion stage 2, but only 5 of the 12 chapter pages are written (Chapters 1, 7, 8, 11 and 12), plus Achievements, Characters, Cheats, Controls and Enemies, so it was not used. deadspace.fandom.com answers the API under "Dead Space (2023)", with about 77 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 10 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the later campaign chapter as a placeholder, though their unlock rates (4 to 47%) suggest they are spread through the whole game. The campaign is split in two at chapter 6. RAWG's description does not use the word remake; the remake is identified by its 2023 RAWG entry, its separate Steam app and StrategyWiki listing both years on one page.
